_source: Remaster data for a Phantasie III import from the Amiga copy alone (profile p3-amiga-1.0), applied by the importer (OpenPhantasie.Importer.Pipelines.P3Amiga.P3AmigaTables.Write) to the GameData P3AmigaTables builds. User s209: DOS for all eight Amiga != DOS differences (reverse-engineering/amiga/phantasie3/FORMAT.md, 'Game tables for a standalone import'), so III plays the same whichever version was imported.
_note: Every cell where the Amiga-built tables differ from DOS III's, provenance aside: 1 HP dice (whole rows: the Amiga's 21 levels, DOS's 22, L16..22 = L15), 2 training gold L16..20, 3 Parry Wizard L15, 4 terrain monster offsets 16..25, 5 the 54 Scandor cells (Pendragon's tile too), 6 the place tiles' terrain (ranges, other), 7 Scroll III's pages, 8 text (treasure articles, Flame Arrow, spell #53, dungeon 2, the inns, terrain names). Also the three entries the Amiga does not have or that nothing reads (the curves' index 0, the terrain offsets' entry 0): DOS's, so the loader takes the files. When DOS III's tables are imported too they win and none of this is used.
_dos_cells: As phantasie1/amiga-import.json (CellPatches): a path into the GameData file the Amiga import builds; a string is an object key, a number an array index. A cell holding the Amiga value takes the DOS value; one holding neither is kept and warned. Whole arrays where the lengths differ.
